subject: Bounded serving I/O with retained late-worker ownership and persistence representation regressions

sources.use: Design and fault-injection precedent only; no source copied. The PR remains open/draft. Retain storage ownership after a deadline instead of pretending the underlying call was cancelled.
Test-design precedent only; no source copied. Exhaustive BF16 bit-pattern, strided, mixed-dtype and fresh-manager persistence oracles exercise MLX2's existing native safetensors representation.

modifications: Bound APC background spill settlement with one shared batch deadline; revoke timed-out publication while retaining evaluated payloads until the writer returns.
Keep spill quarantine across clear/unload so replacing APC instances cannot accumulate hung write windows. Late completion removes files and releases quarantine.

Run production streamed expert and dense reads, including singleton requests, through fixed daemon I/O workers. Reject further reads after a timeout and defer descriptor closure until all running calls return.
Refuse replacement weight pools while timed-out or closing pools retain reads; queued calls can be cancelled but running system calls cannot.
Report outstanding/failed/timed-out weight reads and retained/blocked spill state.

Exercise real late writes, iterator abandonment, descriptor lifetime, permanently hung-reader process exit, BF16 codec representation, target/draft/RNG/hidden state refault, and corrupt-component atomic refusal.

Bound initial APC payload writes on the existing writer after model-thread payload evaluation; a synchronous fallback first settles the bounded background window rather than adding another queue behind a blocked write.

Bound APC payload verification, block materialization and byte reads on one retained I/O worker. Limit serialized staging to the expected resident byte estimate plus a 16 MiB metadata allowance and deserialize target/draft/aux on the model thread; a timed-out read pool permanently refuses further reads.

Apply the same descriptor-lease, bounded queue and deadline mechanism to PLE foreground reads, optional prefetch and adaptive warming, including serial policy. Compute MLX hash constants before submitting host-only NumPy prefetch callbacks.

Add no-waiter prefetch watchdog, idempotent fail/close, bounded refault staging and caller-thread deserialization tests. Update existing APC fault-injection seams to the evaluated payload serializer and distinguish background policy from thread identity.

Confirm existing dynamic expert/KV guard integration: admission subtracts currently unfilled expert/dense reservation, default APC sizing uses that same reserve, and OOM recovery uses the full reservation. No new adaptive allocation policy or performance claim.

Cross-review repairs: autonomous read deadlines also reject late completion when the consumer or watchdog is delayed; atomic packed/dequantized PLE cache publication cannot race pool revocation; failed writer diagnostics no longer retain payload tracebacks; persisted refault checksums bind the exact staged bytes rather than a previous path read.

limits: Follow-up peer-survey-apc-metadata-accounting.json bounds live manifest writes and payload/manifest deletion and removes hot accounting filesystem reads. Startup inventory/security/quarantine/lock acquisition and ordinary-close lock release remain synchronous; this is not universal interruptible filesystem I/O.

The APC serialized restore window is a separately bounded transient host allocation, reported as reserved staging bytes; it is not a zero-copy restore or an adaptive physical-memory allocation policy.
A poisoned streamed weight, PLE or APC read pool refuses further reads and requires owner reload after retained I/O drains; running system calls are not cancelled.

Raw reader utilities explicitly constructed without a pool remain synchronous; production streamed-weight installation always supplies the bounded pool. Initial artifact validation and metadata discovery are outside the serving payload deadlines.
The separate opt-in ordinary B1 exact checkpoint slice is recorded in peer-survey-exact-decode-checkpoint.json. Decode-token prompt replay remains refused on every route.
All validation is focused CPU functional coverage, not GPU qualification, performance qualification or a full preflight.
